Bug_Title: "equals" methods should be symmetric and work for subclasses
Bug_Explanation: The equals method in the Fruit class does not work correctly for subclasses like Raspberry. In the showBug method, when a Raspberry object is compared with a Fruit object, it returns false. But when a Fruit object is compared with a Raspberry object, it returns true. This breaks the symmetry principle of the equals method.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggered the bug by comparing a Raspberry object with a Fruit object and vice versa. The symmetry principle of the equals method was broken when the results of the comparisons were not equal.
